roleLabel: One of the first social communicators of Riacho He Hé
summary: Norma Edith Bedoya, known to many as Norma de Vargas, spent much of her life recording and sharing the everyday history of Riacho He Hé.
openingTitle:
A woman who
told the story
of her town.
paragraphs: Journalist, correspondent, photographer. She was also the person who brought newspapers and magazines to the town.

chapters.title: Pioneer of communication
paragraphs: Norma was a journalist, correspondent and photographer. Her work recorded events, institutions, public works and people who were building the everyday history of Riacho He Hé.
Delivering newspapers and magazines was part of that same craft: bringing the news to where people live.

chapters.title:
The news
that told
a town
paragraphs: For years she was a correspondent for Diario La Mañana. She documented public works, institutions, events, people and everyday life.
Not for a distant archive. So that Riacho He Hé could see itself.

chapters.title:
Behind every story
there was a life.
paragraphs: She walked streets, institutions, schools and rural settlements. Camera and words were tools for keeping memory.

chapters.title:
She did not only tell
the community.
She also built it.
paragraphs: She took part in the Founding Committee of the Public Library of Riacho He Hé. It was part of her commitment to the town, not a title to display.

chapters.title:
Her town
remembered her too.
paragraphs: The community recognised her work as correspondent for Diario La Mañana. It remains as an archive piece: a recognition from neighbours.

chapters.title:
The woman
behind the journalist
paragraphs: Family was one of the pillars of her life. Those who knew her remember the generosity and the everyday commitment, not only the craft.

bridge.title: What comes next
paragraphs: Norma used communication to tell her community. The intention of this project is that that legacy can inspire new opportunities for other people from Riacho He Hé.
First, rebuild a house. There is not yet a constituted organisation, and no published programme.

portrait.alt: Norma looks at the camera, smiling slightly. She is in her kitchen, wearing a black blouse with white dots. Behind her, a cupboard with glasses and a shelf of framed family photographs.

photos.alt: A close portrait of Norma. She wears a light-blue and blue striped shirt and looks at the camera with a contained smile.
Norma standing in the kitchen in a fuchsia blouse printed with flowers. Beside her, a vase with an open pink flower.
